entities.summary: Victoria Swarovski is an Austrian pop singer, model, television presenter, and businesswoman. She is an heiress to the multi-billion dollar Austrian private company Swarovski, active in fashion, crystal, and jewelry industry. She will co-host the Eurovision Song Contest 2026 in Vienna.
